description.en: The end time of the maintenance window. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 可维护的开始时间。格式：HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The start time of the maintenance window. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.en:
The system maintains AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances during the maintenance window that you specify. We recommend that you set the maintenance window to off-peak hours to minimize the impact on your business.

## Limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-maintain-time --resource-group-id example-string --db-instance-id gp-bp000000000000000 --start-time 02:00Z --end-time 03:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
